source_note: mMRC dyspnea scale grades 0-4 (paraphrased). Other slots and question wording are mine, pending a GOLD citation.

mmrc_grade.question: Which fits you best today? 0: breathless only with hard exercise. 1: breathless hurrying or walking up a slight hill. 2: walk slower than people your age or stop to catch your breath on level ground. 3: stop for breath after about 100 yards or a few minutes on level ground. 4: too breathless to leave the house or breathless when dressing. Reply with the number.

breathless_at_rest.question: Do you get short of breath while sitting still or lying down?

sputum_change.question: Has your phlegm changed color (yellow or green) or increased?

fever.question: Have you had a fever or chills?

rescue_inhaler_per_day.question: How many times a day are you using your rescue inhaler?

chest_pain.question: Have you had any chest pain or chest tightness?
